runtimeNotes: Read recent visual fingerprints before constructing a human-scene prompt.
Astrogen style is a stable palette, light, and refinement layer; scene, action, emotion, gaze, framing, and props must vary.
The plugin rejects a human-scene direction that is too similar before the paid provider call.
The provider output may be accepted at its native size when both dimensions are within the configured 20 percent tolerance and visual QA passes.
